recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future richer examples or operational guidance for choosing ConceptMap versus CodeSystem supplements should be handled as a separate current Vocabulary tracker, not as a fix for this already-applied clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-18675 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked the Vocabulary work group to define the boundary between CodeSystem supplements and ConceptMap, and the approved resolution said to add notes to both resources explaining that ConceptMaps are contextual assertions of concept relationships while CodeSystem supplements define inherent properties and semantics of concepts in the code system.
initial_application: Jira cites git 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249 as the application. That commit added the approved paragraph to source/codesystem/codesystem-introduction.xml and source/conceptmap/conceptmap-introduction.xml as part of terminology ballot documentation updates.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists both conceptmap=ConceptMap and codesystem=CodeSystem as active resources, so the inspected introductions are current build inputs. Current source still contains the requested paragraph in both places. Jira searches for the exact approved text and broader supplement/ConceptMap terms found no later final issue that supersedes this boundary note. Zulip and Confluence searches found background discussion consistent with the distinction and no conflicting FHIR-18675-specific community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current active source already satisfies the approved request in both resource pages, and a wording-only restatement would not change implementer understanding.
